dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is plastic recycled in this building?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːs miː. ɪz ˈplæstɪk riːˈsaɪkəld ɪn ˈðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. Plastic bottles go in the yellow recycling bin.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt ˈɪz. ˈplæstɪk ˈbɑːtəlz ˈɡoʊ ɪn ðə ˈjɛloʊ riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ˌbɪn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, it isn't, sorry. But the supermarket on the corner takes glass bottles.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt, ˈsɑːri. bʌt ðə ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt ɑːn ðə ˈkɔːrnər ˈteɪks ˈɡlæs ˈbɑːtəlz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What about cardboard? We have a lot of boxes.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈkɑːrdbɔːrd? wiː ˈhæv ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈbɑːksɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Cardboard is recycled. Please separate it from the plastic and fold the boxes.
dialogue.reading: ˈkɑːrdbɔːrd ɪz riːˈsaɪkəld. ˈpliːz ˈsɛpəreɪt ɪt frəm ðə ˈplæstɪk ənd ˈfoʊld ðə ˈbɑːksɪz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. When is the waste picked up?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwɛn ɪz ðə ˈweɪst ˈpɪkt ˈʌp?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's picked up every Monday and Thursday.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈpɪkt ˈʌp ˈɛvri ˈmʌndeɪ ənd ˈθɜːrzdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And these coffee cups? What material are they made of?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈðiːz ˈkɔːfi ˈkʌps? ˈwʌt məˈtɪriəl ər ðeɪ ˈmeɪd ˈʌv?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: They look easy to recycle, but they aren't recycled here. There's plastic inside.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈlʊk ˈiːzi tə riːˈsaɪkəl, bʌt ðeɪ ˈɑːrnt riːˈsaɪkəld ˈhɪr. ðɛrz ˈplæstɪk ˌɪnˈsaɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then I'll use a reusable cup from now on.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈjuːz ə ˌriːˈjuːzəbəl ˈkʌp frəm ˈnaʊ ˈɑːn.
